title: Workers' compensation default values
text:
Workers' compensation default values

Default values for workers' compensation:
The following table lists 
Touchstone
 default occupancy
 rates for the percentage of covered employees at a location during specified times.
 Occupancy rates vary with the day of the week. Assumed occupancy times are Monday
 through Saturday. Assumed occupancy rates for Sunday are the same as the nighttime rates
 shown. Holidays are handled like any other day.

| Occupancy Category | Night
 (7 pm - 6:59 am) | Day
 (9 am - 4:59 pm) | Commute
 (7 am - 8:59 am,
 5 pm - 6:59 pm) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Residential (codes
 301-310) | 0.99 | 0.80 | 0.95 |
| Commercial (codes
 311-320) | 0.02 | 0.98 | 0.50 |
| Industrial (codes 321-330, Industrial
 Facilities (400-series codes) | 0.10 | 0.80 | 0.50 |
| Other (including unknown ) | 0.02 | 0.98 | 0.50 |

Personal accident default values

Touchstone

 accident default values for the percentage of covered employees who will be at the
 location during the specified times:

| Occupancy Category | Morning
 (6 am - 5:59 pm) | Night
 (6 pm - 5:59 am) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Residential (codes
 301-310) | 0.80 | 0.99 |
| Industrial (codes 321-330, Industrial
 Facilities (400-series codes) | 0.98 | 0.02 |

 Facilities (400-series codes) | 0.80 | 0.10 |
| Other (including unknown ) | 0.98 | 0.02 |
